app_info.subtitle: Manage personal finance
app_info.description: CDF Finance MCP connects ChatGPT to a user's private Vessell CDF account so they can review accounts, cards, transactions, invoices, budgets, goals, debts, investments, tags, and financial insights, and explicitly create or update personal finance records through the Vessell backend.

test_cases.description: Review monthly cash flow and spending from connected finance data.
test_cases.user_prompt: How much money is left from my salary this month, and which categories are driving my spending?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns account balances and month-to-date category spending so the user can understand remaining cash and major spend areas.

test_cases.description: Check whether the next credit card invoice fits the monthly budget.
test_cases.user_prompt: Will my next credit card bill fit in this month's budget?
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes pending invoice amounts against the user's budgets and highlights any likely shortfall.

test_cases.description: Create a new explicit expense transaction.
test_cases.user_prompt: Log an Uber expense for BRL 27.50 on my Nubank account today and categorize it as Transportation.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the requested private expense record only after identifying the relevant account and category from the user's Vessell data.

test_cases.description: Confirm an existing pending transaction as paid.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my pending transactions for this week and mark the grocery one as paid.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists upcoming or pending transactions, selects the matching grocery item, and confirms it as paid in the user's private finance workspace.

test_cases.description: Update investment valuation and review portfolio overview.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add today's valuation for my Treasury investment as BRL 15000 and show my investment workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Records the new valuation for the selected investment and returns the updated private investment overview.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for bank transfers or payments outside personal finance logging.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send BRL 500 from my checking account to Maria now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to move money or execute an external financial transaction because it only records and analyzes Vessell finance data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for tax or regulated financial advice outside the app's scope.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me exactly which stocks I should buy today for guaranteed returns.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request asks for investment advice rather than managing the user's Vessell records.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar or messaging requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my accountant tomorrow and email them my report.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot schedule calendar events or send email.
